the blood glucose level has a negligible effect on the FDG uptake in the liver, spleens and bone marrow, while it has a slightly positive effect on the FDGs uptake in the muscles.
the effect of hyperglycemia at FDG-PET on the studied normal tissue is restricted to a slight increase in the muscular uptake.

the influence of the blood sugar level on the tracer accumulation of normal tissues in clinical PET examinations.
the effect of hyperglycemia on the FDG uptake in normal tissues and the blood activity at normal FDG-PET examinations.
the effect of blood glucose levels on the tracer uptake in tissues/organs at FDG PET.

hyperglycaemia has no major impact on FDG uptake in normal tissue, and thus on the interpretation of FDG PET examinations.

hyperglycaemia is a minor problem in the interpretation of FDG PET examinations.
